conditions: A function argument bound through the described shallow-binding mechanism in the documented Interlisp-10 implementation.
limitations: The documented storage scheme is implementation- and revision-specific. Local compiler declarations, context-switching details and measured performance are outside this claim.

triggers: Newly available contemporaneous originals, archive byte drift, corrected bibliographic data, or contrary edition, identity, or target evidence.

statement: The October 1978 manual describes Interlisp-10 shallow argument binding as storing each new binding in the variable’s value cell, saving its previous value in the call’s basic frame, and restoring the previous value on function exit.
